answer: Mechanism: deposit + arbitration forfeiture. Before voting or grading, every identity must place 50 USDC in an arbitration escrow, bind the deposit to one public key, and submit a GPS hash from a separate knoll (elevation ≥1 m) as a location relic. A 1000-clone farm pays 50,000 USDC and loses it all when arbitration flags the clone pattern, marking each invalid account with a violet status. Honesty stays cheaper.
